profile.headline: Software Developer at Dayton Freight Lines, Inc.
profile.summary: Hello, I'm Sarah. I am a professional, creative and motivated software developer obsessed with creative thinking, teamwork, and continuous learning. I’m still a noob in most ways when it comes to programming but I’m getting better with RPGLE, Node.js, and Db2.

positions.title: Java Development Bootcamp Student
positions.description:
Recently graduated Java bootcamp student from Tech Elevator. Below is a list of projects I've completed during my time here:
• Catering System Program: Created a functioning Java program that emulated a catering service and accepted user inputs. Users were given access to a menu that allowed them to view a list of food items read in from a text file, add money to their account, select food items for purchase, add items to cart, get a checkout receipt, and receive change back based on remaining balance
• Venue Reservation Service: Developed an interactive Java program using the skills learned in the first capstone. This program read in data from a SQL database instead of a text file and allowed users to book a reservation at a venue based on their specific needs
• Funds Transfer API: Engineered an interactive Java API program. This program read in data from a SQL database on the server side which then created url paths allowing a user to access and edit the information from a client side with menu commands
• City Tours: Created a functioning full stack program using PostgreSQL, Java, Spring Boot, REST, Vue.js, HTML, and CSS. This program displayed landmarks and locations that users might want to visit and allowed users to plan a trip that included the selected locations

positions.title: Chiropractic Assistant / Receptionist
positions.description:
Responsibilities included but were not limited to:
• ​Greeting patients, answering questions, assisting patients with paperwork, scheduling appointments
• Managed busy front desk, ordered office supplies, handled incoming and outgoing calls, maintained communication with off-site office manager
• Communicated with insurance companies, the BWC, and law firms on patients' behalf between ten and twenty times per day
• Trained and evaluated over ten new hires over the course of a two years period

positions.title: Photo Laboratory Technician
positions.description:
Responsibilities included but were not limited to:​
• Maintained photo lab equipment including ordering ink and replacing parts, disassembling and cleaning, and making minor repairs
• Assisted customers at photo kiosk with mobile device connectivity and visual design of products
• Processed, priced, filed, and retrieved customers photo orders in a timely manner
